name: Renew IP Configuration
description: Requests a fresh IP address from your network to fix connection issues or invalid settings.

description_i18n.en: Requests a fresh IP address from your network to fix connection issues or invalid settings.
description_i18n.de: Fordert eine neue IP-Adresse vom Netzwerk an, um Verbindungsprobleme oder ungültige Einstellungen zu beheben.
description_i18n.fr: Demande une nouvelle adresse IP au réseau pour résoudre les problèmes de connexion ou des paramètres invalides.

warnings.title: Temporary connectivity loss
warnings.message: Network connection may briefly drop while the IP address is renewed and applied to your adapter

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the ipconfig /renew command to obtain a new lease from your DHCP server This action resets network configuration for active adapters without changing DNS or proxy settings
